name: pl-subdiv-minc
title: Subdivide Masks
description: A ChRIS plugin wrapper around mincresample for increasing the resolution of binary images.

parameters.name: divisions
parameters.help: number of cuts along voxel edge. Float values are accepted, mincresample performs interpolation.

parameters.name: options
parameters.help: Additional options to pass to mincresample as space-separated list, e.g. specify interpolation as -tricubic or -trilinear

parameters.name: binarize
parameters.help: Skip extra step minccalc -expr A[0]>0.5, allowing for floating point values

parameters.name: threads
parameters.help: number of threads to use (pass 0 to use number of visible CPU cores)

parameters.name: no_fail
parameters.help: Exit normally even when failed to process a subject
